33371.a:
```sh
cmd < input.txt          # stdin fayldan
cmd > out.txt            # stdout faylga (ustidan yozish)
cmd >> out.txt           # stdout qo'shish
cmd 2> err.txt           # faqat stderr
cmd > all.txt 2>&1       # ikkalasi bitta faylga
cmd &> all.txt           # bash qisqa yozuvi (bir xil)
cmd 2>/dev/null          # xatolarni yashirish
cmd > /dev/null 2>&1     # hammasini jim qilish (cron'da ko'p)
ls -l /proc/$$/fd        # joriy shell'ning fd'lari
```
stderr alohida bo'lishining sababi: pipe faqat stdout'ni keyingi buyruqqa uzatadi, xatolar ekranda ko'rinib qoladi va ma'lumotni buzmaydi.

33372.a:
```sh
ls /yoq /tmp > out.txt 2>&1    # out.txt: ikkalasi
ls /yoq /tmp 2>&1 > out.txt    # xato ekranda, faqat ro'yxat faylda
```
`2>&1` = "fd 2'ni fd 1 **hozir** ko'rsatayotgan joyga nusxala" (dup2), ko'rsatkich emas.
Pipe bilan: `cmd 2>&1 | grep x` — stderr ham pipe'ga kiradi; bash'da `cmd |& grep x`.

33373.a:
```sh
# bitta arxivga
find /var/log/app -name '*.log' -mtime -1 -print0 | \
  tar --null -czf logs-$(date +%F).tar.gz --files-from=-

# har birini alohida siqish
find /var/log/app -name '*.log' -mtime -1 -exec gzip -k {} +

# 7 kundan eski .gz'larni o'chirish (avval -print bilan tekshiring!)
find /var/log/app -name '*.gz' -mtime +7 -print
find /var/log/app -name '*.gz' -mtime +7 -delete
```
`-mtime -1` = 24 soatdan yangi, `+7` = 7 kundan eski (to'liq kunlar bo'yicha yaxlitlanadi). Aniqroq: `-newermt "2026-10-01 00:00"`.

33374.a:
```sh
# ko'rib chiqish (o'zgartirmaydi)
sed 's/db-old.internal/db.internal/g' config.yaml | diff config.yaml -

# zaxira bilan joyida
sed -i.bak 's/db-old.internal/db.internal/g' config.yaml

# ko'p faylda
grep -rl 'db-old.internal' /etc/app | xargs sed -i 's/db-old\.internal/db.internal/g'

# / ko'p bo'lsa boshqa ajratuvchi
sed -i 's|/opt/old|/opt/new|g' *.conf
```
Gotcha: macOS (BSD) `sed -i` argument talab qiladi: `sed -i '' 's/a/b/' f`. Regex'da `.` har qanday belgini bildiradi — `\.` bilan ekranlang.

33375.a:
```sh
awk '{print $1}' access.log                     # birinchi ustun (IP)
awk -F: '{print $1, $7}' /etc/passwd            # user va shell
awk '$9 >= 500 {print $7}' access.log           # 5xx bo'lgan URL'lar
awk '{s += $10} END {print s/1024/1024 " MB"}' access.log   # jami trafik
awk 'NR==10, NR==20' file                       # 10-20 qatorlar
awk '{print $NF}' file                          # oxirgi ustun
df -h | awk 'NR>1 && $5+0 > 80 {print $6, $5}'  # 80% dan to'la disklar
```
Oddiy holatda `cut -d: -f1` ham bo'ladi, lekin `cut` ketma-ket bo'shliqlarni bitta deb hisoblamaydi — `awk` hisoblaydi.

33376.a:
```sh
printf 'a\nb\na\n' | uniq          # a b a  (noto'g'ri)
printf 'a\nb\na\n' | sort | uniq   # a b

# eng ko'p uchragan 10 ta IP
awk '{print $1}' access.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head

du -sh * | sort -h                     # hajm bo'yicha
sort -t, -k3,3n data.csv              # 3-ustun son bo'yicha
sort -u emails.txt                    # = sort | uniq
```
Gotcha: `sort -n` "10K"ni tushunmaydi — `-h`. Locale tartibni o'zgartiradi: barqaror natija uchun `LC_ALL=C sort`.

33377.a:
```sh
head -n 5 file
tail -n 100 /var/log/syslog
tail -n +2 data.csv                 # sarlavhasiz
sed -n '100,120p' big.log           # 100-120 qatorlar
tail -F /var/log/nginx/access.log   # logrotate'dan keyin ham ishlaydi
tail -f app.log | grep --line-buffered ERROR
head -c 1M /dev/urandom > test.bin  # bayt bo'yicha
```
`-f` fayl deskriptorini kuzatadi: logrotate faylni ko'chirsa, eski (endi bo'sh) faylga qarab qolasiz — shuning uchun `-F`.

33378.a:
```sh
cut -d, -f1,3 users.csv              # 1 va 3-ustun
cut -c1-8 hashes.txt                 # birinchi 8 belgi
echo "Hello" | tr 'a-z' 'A-Z'        # HELLO
tr -d '\r' < win.txt > unix.txt      # Windows CRLF ni tozalash
tr -s ' ' < file                     # ketma-ket bo'shliqlarni bittaga
wc -l access.log                     # qatorlar soni
ls | wc -l
paste -sd+ nums.txt | bc             # ustundagi sonlar yig'indisi
mount | column -t                    # tekislangan jadval
```
`$'\r'` (CRLF) — "bad interpreter: /bin/bash^M" xatosining sababi; `dos2unix` yoki `tr -d '\r'`.

33379.a:
```sh
ps aux | grep nginx         # ... grep --color=auto nginx ham chiqadi
ps aux | grep '[n]ginx'     # grep o'zi chiqmaydi
pgrep -a nginx              # PID + buyruq
pgrep -u www-data -c nginx  # soni
pidof nginx
ps -o pid,ppid,%cpu,%mem,etime,cmd -C nginx
systemctl status nginx      # systemd servis bo'lsa eng aniq
```
Skriptda `ps | grep | wc -l` bilan "ishlayaptimi" tekshirish xato beradi (grep hisobga kiradi) — `pgrep -x` yoki `systemctl is-active`.

33380.a:
```sh
apt install htop
sudo !!                        # = sudo apt install htop
mkdir -p /opt/app/releases && cd !$
history | grep docker
!123                           # 123-buyruqni qayta
Ctrl+R  -> "kubectl"           # orqaga qidiruv, yana Ctrl+R keyingisi
```
Xavfsizlik: buyruqda parol yozilsa tarixda qoladi. Bo'shliq bilan boshlang (`HISTCONTROL=ignorespace`) yoki parolni env/fayldan o'qing; `history -d N` bilan o'chirish.

33381.a:
```sh
diff -u nginx.conf.orig nginx.conf > nginx.patch
patch --dry-run -p0 < nginx.patch
patch -p0 < nginx.patch

diff -rq dir1/ dir2/                         # qaysi fayllar farq qiladi
diff <(ssh web1 cat /etc/nginx/nginx.conf) <(ssh web2 cat /etc/nginx/nginx.conf)
diff <(sort a.txt) <(sort b.txt)
vimdiff a b                                  # interaktiv
cmp -s a b && echo bir-xil                    # binary, jim
```
`diff` exit code: 0 — bir xil, 1 — farq bor, 2 — xato. Skriptda `set -e` bilan ehtiyot.

33382.a:
```sh
sha256sum app-1.5.0.tar.gz
sha256sum -c app-1.5.0.tar.gz.sha256       # rasmiy checksum bilan
sha256sum *.tar.gz > SHA256SUMS
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --quiet

# ko'chirishdan keyin
ssh backup sha256sum /backups/db.sql.gz
```
- Checksum faqat checksum ishonchli manbadan kelsa ma'noli (HTTPS, GPG imzo: `gpg --verify`).
- `rsync -c` — fayllarni hash bo'yicha solishtiradi.
- Katta fayllar uchun tezroq: `b3sum` (BLAKE3).

33383.a:
```sh
file backup.tar.gz          # gzip compressed data
file /usr/bin/ls            # ELF 64-bit ... dynamically linked
stat -c '%n %s bayt %U:%G %a %y' app.log
touch -d '2026-10-01 00:00' marker && find . -newer marker
basename /var/log/nginx/access.log .log    # access
dirname  /var/log/nginx/access.log         # /var/log/nginx
realpath ./../conf
```
Vaqtlar: mtime — mazmun o'zgardi, ctime — metadata (chmod/chown) o'zgardi, atime — o'qildi (ko'pincha `relatime` bilan kam yangilanadi). "Yaratilgan vaqt" — `stat`dagi Birth (FS qo'llasa).

33384.a:
```sh
# to'g'ri
while IFS= read -r host; do
  ssh -n "$host" uptime          # -n: ssh stdin'ni yutib qo'ymasin!
done < hosts.txt

# xato: "my file.txt" ikkiga bo'linadi
for f in $(cat list.txt); do ...; done

# o'zgaruvchi saqlanishi uchun pipe emas, process substitution
count=0
while read -r _; do count=$((count+1)); done < <(grep ERROR app.log)
echo "$count"
```
Klassik bug: siklda `ssh` faqat birinchi host'da ishlaydi — ssh qolgan stdin'ni o'qib oladi; `ssh -n` yoki `< /dev/null`.

33385.a:
```sh
lsblk                                            # avval qurilmani ANIQ toping
sudo dd if=ubuntu.iso of=/dev/sdX bs=4M status=progress conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=test.img bs=1M count=1024     # 1GB fayl
sudo dd if=/dev/sda of=mbr.bin bs=512 count=1     # MBR zaxirasi
dd if=/dev/zero of=/tmp/t bs=1M count=1024 oflag=direct   # yozish tezligi (taxminiy)
```
- `if` = input, `of` = output. Teskari yozish = ma'lumot yo'qoladi.
- Haqiqiy disk benchmark uchun `fio` (dd ketma-ket bitta oqim, cache ta'sir qiladi).
- Bo'sh fayl tez yaratish: `fallocate -l 1G f` yoki `truncate -s 1G f` (sparse).

33386.a:
```sh
df -h /var        # 100%
du -sh /var       # ancha kam — farq "deleted but open" fayllarda
sudo lsof +L1 | grep /var/log
# java  1234 app  7w  REG  ... 21474836480 0 /var/log/app.log (deleted)

: | sudo tee /proc/1234/fd/7 > /dev/null    # truncate, jarayon yozishda davom etadi
# yoki: sudo truncate -s 0 /proc/1234/fd/7
sudo systemctl reload app                    # faylni qayta ochadi
```
Oldini olish: katta log'ni `rm` emas, `truncate -s 0 file` yoki `: > file` bilan tozalang; logrotate'da `postrotate` (reload) yoki `copytruncate`.
